Logic Analysis: pom.xml

dependency/build; Maven project descriptor targeting Java 11; declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter as test-scoped dependency; configure maven-surefire-plugin (version that runs JUnit 5, e.g., 3.1.2); compiler plugin set to 11; single test target path src/test/java/MainTest.java; no external runtime deps
src/main/java/Main.java

runtime/bootstrap; thin demo in default package; wires OfflineDeterministicAdapter and VideoDownloader; enqueues two downloads; starts pending; ticks a few iterations; prints statuses/progress/output names; exits deterministically without long-running loops or I/O
src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java

domain-entity; enumeration of supported download formats (e.g., MP4, WEBM) and canonical extensions; public static fromExtension(String) to resolve format by extension; defaultExtension() returns canonical extension for the enum constant; pure and side-effect-free
src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java

pure-rule; URL validation and safe output naming helpers; isValidUrl(String) validates scheme and basic structure without network access; sanitizeName(String) returns filesystem-safe base name (strip dangerous chars, trim, normalize spaces); withExtension(String, DownloadFormat) appends canonical extension to sanitized base name; pure functions
src/main/java/VideoDownloadRequest.java

domain-entity; value object representing a requested download; static factory of(url, format, suggestedName) validates URL via ValidationUtils and computes outputName via sanitizeName + withExtension; getters for url, format, suggestedName, outputName; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid url/format/suggestedName null
src/main/java/DownloadStatus.java
domain-entity; enumeration of lifecycle statuses: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED; used by DownloadTask and VideoDownloader
src/main/java/ProgressListener.java

interface; progress callback boundary used by TransferAdapter/TransferSession; onProgress(downloaded, total) invoked on each transfer step; onCompleted() on transfer completion; onFailed(message) on failure; no environment dependencies
src/main/java/TransferAdapter.java

interface; boundary to begin a transfer session; begin(url, format, outputName, listener) returns a TransferSession; decouples domain from environment/network; used by DownloadTask.start() and VideoDownloader orchestration
src/main/java/TransferSession.java

interface; boundary representing an in-progress transfer; step() performs one deterministic chunk and returns true if more steps remain; cancel() stops the session; getTotalBytes() and getDownloadedBytes() expose progress; used by DownloadTask to compute progress percent
src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java

environment-dependent; deterministic offline implementation of TransferAdapter and TransferSession; begin() creates a session with fixed total bytes (e.g., 1000) and fixed per-step chunk (e.g., 100); calls ProgressListener on each step and on completion; supports cancel(); no network or filesystem; designed for tests and demo
src/main/java/DownloadTask.java

domain-entity; state machine for a single download; fields: id, request, status, session, progress percent; start(adapter) validates state and begins session with internally wired ProgressListener that updates progress and status; tick() advances session one step and updates status; cancel() cancels session and sets status to CANCELLED idempotently; getters for id/status/progress/outputName
src/main/java/VideoDownloader.java

orchestration; canonical public API managing tasks and queue lifecycle; holds TransferAdapter, Map<Integer, DownloadTask>, and nextId; requestDownload(url, format, suggestedName) creates VideoDownloadRequest and stores PENDING task with new id; startPending() starts all PENDING; tick() advances all RUNNING tasks; cancel(taskId) cancels a task; getters for status/progress/outputName by id; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown ids
src/test/java/MainTest.java

automated-test; JUnit 5 tests using canonical API only; deterministic offline runtime wiring test, validation/naming rule checks, progress reaching 100%, and cancellation behavior; no network or UI; concise (2–4 tests under ~150 LOC)

environment_test_coupling_risks: Tests use OfflineDeterministicAdapter explicitly as the environment-dependent boundary per design; no other environment leakage into tests.

Shared Knowledge:
The build uses Maven with Java 11 and JUnit Jupiter via Surefire. All classes live in the default package under src/main/java to avoid package mismatch. The canonical public API consists of VideoDownloader (orchestration), DownloadTask (single-task state machine), VideoDownloadRequest (value object), DownloadFormat, ValidationUtils, DownloadStatus, ProgressListener, TransferAdapter, and TransferSession. OfflineDeterministicAdapter is the deterministic environment boundary used by Main and tests. The single test file src/test/java/MainTest.java imports only VideoDownloader, OfflineDeterministicAdapter, DownloadFormat, and DownloadStatus, and asserts deterministic progress/completion, naming/validation rules, and cancellation. Main provides a thin runtime demo and does not affect tests.
